title: astragalus bisulcatus var. major
intro: Astragalus bisulcatus var. major, commonly known as the Wyoming milkvetch, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the legume family (Fabaceae). It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to promote overall health and well-being, with reported health benefits including immunomodulatory, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Astragalus bisulcatus var. major include enhancing immune function, reducing oxidative stress, and exhibiting anti-viral and anti-bacterial properties. The plant's bioactive constituents include isoflavones, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
